fields.name: TimeoutMs
fields.about: The maximum time to wait for the request to complete before returning.

fields.name: VoterId
fields.about: The replica id of the voter getting added to the topic partition.

fields.name: VoterDirectoryId
fields.about: The directory id of the voter getting added to the topic partition.

fields.name: Listeners
fields.about: The endpoints that can be used to communicate with the voter.

fields.name: AckWhenCommitted
fields.about: When true, return a response after the new voter set is committed. Otherwise, return after the leader writes the changes locally.
